context: The skill should write simple Optional transform/filter/fallback code without null or presence-check value-read control flow.

checklist.name: Uses transform/filter boundary
checklist.description: Uses rawLabel.map(String::trim).filter(...).orElse("untitled") or an equivalent direct Optional transform/filter/fallback boundary.

checklist.name: No presence-check value read
checklist.description: Does not use isPresent()/isEmpty() followed by get() or orElseThrow() for ordinary fallback.

checklist.name: No null or fake collection workaround
checklist.description: Does not use orElse(null), local null branching, Optional.stream().toList(), or a loop over one Optional.

checklist.name: Preserves label behavior
checklist.description: Returns the trimmed nonblank label when present and untitled for absent or blank labels.
